## TL;DR

Review pass 8: merged current `main` into the feature branch (including #1057 and sibling task bookkeeping). Periodic completed-capture reaping now parses the task id from `repoos-validate-<taskId>-<suffix>` and appends a Debug remote-validation event with `reason=completed-capture-idle`, container name, and age — not only a system.log line.

## Work and rationale

The shared `runValidationContainerReaper` already removed quiet completed captures during the host probe tick, but operators watching a task’s Debug tab saw nothing unless the startup sweep or in-run force-collection fired. Container names embed the numeric task id from the artifacts path segment, so parsing avoids an extra SSH env probe in the common case (env inspect remains fallback for legacy names).

Event text includes idle detail plus structured reason/container/age so pass-8 observability criteria are met without changing #1049 stale-validation reaper rules.

## Approaches tried

Name-first task id resolution with `REPOOS_BROWSER_CAPTURE_TASK` fallback keeps older containers observable without duplicating reaper logic per provider.

## Challenges and blockers

Merge from `main` applied cleanly in this worktree after fetch; no conflict markers remained in `capture-browser.ts` or `remote-validation.ts` at merge time.

## Key learnings

Periodic infrastructure actions that affect a specific task should always fan out to that task’s event stream when the container name carries the identity.
